## InstaPay Plus Payment Guide for Merchants ### Where can I find the On-Demand withdrawal option? A dedicated withdrawal section will appear in your Courier Merchant Portal dashboard, showing your total withdrawable balance. Source: https://help.pathao.com/where-can-i-find-the-on-demand-withdrawal-option/

### Who can use InstaPay On-Demand? Only merchants added to the eligible On-Demand cohort will get access. If you are added, you will see the On-Demand withdrawal option in your Courier Merchant Portal. Source: https://help.pathao.com/who-can-use-instapay-on-demand/

### How is On-Demand different from regular InstaPay? • Regular InstaPay → Sends daily payouts (3 cycles) automatically. • On-Demand → You manually withdraw only when you need money.If you use On-Demand, regular InstaPay will automatically be turned off. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-is-on-demand-different-from-regular-instapay/

### What is InstaPay On-Demand? InstaPay On-Demand is a flexible withdrawal feature that lets courier merchants withdraw their COD money anytime they need. It does not require enabling regular InstaPay. Merchants continue using their normal payout method but can instantly transfer funds to their Pathao Pay Merchant Account whenever needed. Source: https://help.pathao.com/what-is-instapay-on-demand/

### When You May Not Be Able to Withdraw InstaPay Plus withdrawal may be restricted if: • You have reached your maximum outstanding limit • Your account does not meet eligibility criteria • System risk controls temporarily restrict access Source: https://help.pathao.com/7-when-you-may-not-be-able-to-withdraw/

### Important Things to Know • InstaPay Plus eligibility and limits are updated daily • You must withdraw the full approved amount (no partial withdrawals) • Available InstaPay Plus may change throughout the day as order statuses update • This feature is available only to eligible merchants Source: https://help.pathao.com/6-important-things-to-know/

### How Repayment Works InstaPay Plus repayment is automated and seamless. • When an order is successfully delivered → the InstaPay Plus is adjusted from the collected COD • If an order is returned or failed → the corresponding amount becomes due • Any outstanding due is recovered from future successful deliveries or can be manually paid in the due option in the merchant dashboard. Source: https://help.pathao.com/5-how-repayment-works/

### Fees & Charges A service fee is applied to each InstaPay Plus disbursement. The exact fee amount will be clearly shown before confirmation, and the merchant will receive the amount after the service charge has been deducted. No hidden charges apply Source: https://help.pathao.com/4-fees-charges/

### How to Withdraw InstaPay Plus? Withdrawing your InstaPay Plus is simple: • Go to your dashboard • Click on the “Get Payment” button on the InstaPay Plus widget. • Confirm the transaction Once confirmed, the full approved amount will be instantly transferred to your Pathao Pay Merchant Wallet. Note: Partial withdrawals are not supported. Source: https://help.pathao.com/3-how-to-withdraw-instapay-plus/

### How is the InstaPay Plus Amount Calculated? Your eligible InstaPay Plus amount is calculated daily based on your picked-up consignments. The system considers: • Total value of picked-up COD orders • Predefined InstaPay Plus percentage • Merchant eligibility, limits, and risk rules The amount displayed in your dashboard represents the InstaPay Plus amount you can withdraw for that day. Source: https://help.pathao.com/2-how-is-the-instapay-plus-amount-calculated/

### What is InstaPay Plus Payment? InstaPay Plus Payment is a feature that allows merchants to receive a portion of their expected Cash on Delivery (COD) collections based on the “Sorted” status visible in the merchant dashboard. This helps improve cash flow and ensures you have working capital available when needed. Source: https://help.pathao.com/1-what-is-instapay-plus-payment/

Demand) | 120 | 120 | 150 | 150 | Note: For cash on delivery orders, 1% COD charge will be applicable for all deliveries. The return charge is 50% of the delivery cost (Not applicable for Dhaka metro orders) Source: https://help.pathao.com/what-is-the-delivery-charge-inside-or-outside-the-city/

## New Merchant ### Can I work with Pathao by integrating Pathao’s panel with my website? Sure, you can integrate your website’s API with Pathao’s Merchant panel. You can do this from the Developer API option in Pathao’s merchant panel. Source: https://help.pathao.com/integrate-pathao-panel-with-website/

### Pickup requests must be confirmed by how many hours per day? For same day delivery panel entry should be done by selecting express delivery before 12 noon and panel entry should be confirmed before 4 pm for standard delivery. Source: https://help.pathao.com/pickup-requests-confirmation-hours/

### I don’t have a Facebook page/website, can I register as a merchant of Pathao? Facebook page/website is not mandatory to join as a merchant. Source: https://help.pathao.com/no-facebook-or-website-merchant-registration-pathao/

### How can I track my order? Go to “Deliveries” option from the panel. From there click on “All” option and you can view and check the details of the parcel you want to check. Source: https://help.pathao.com/track-order/

### What to do if a product is lost or damaged? Please order information and With before and after pictures of damage The panel can issue a report on that order in the following ways- > Click on the product you are facing the problem from the Deliveries option of the Dashboard panel > Select the issue type by clicking on Report Issue option from More, enter details and attach image and submit.Or email us at ecomsupport@pathao.com with order information and before and after photos of damage from your registered email. Source: https://help.pathao.com/product-lost-damaged/

### How can I issue reports? > Please go to the Deliveries option from merchant panel. > View the Consignment Id that encountered the problem. > Go to More option and click Report Issue from the dropdown. > Then a popup window will appear, select problem type, enter details and attach image (if any) and submit. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-can-i-issue-reports/

### How and for how long can I hold my product? We can hold the product for a maximum of 3 days as there is a chance of damage to the product. If a hold is required for more than 3 days, please issue a report in the following ways: > If an Account Manager (CAM) has been assigned for you, you (CAM) should inform the matter. > Click on the product that you are facing the problem from the Deliveries option of the Panel Dashboard > Click on the More > Report Issue option. Select the type of problem there, enter the description and attach the image (if any) and submit. If possible, we will try to hold. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-long-can-i-hold-my-product/

### How do I return a product from a customer / make an entry for Reverse Pickup? If a parcel delivered by Pathao Courier needs to be returned, view the delivered consignment order in the Deliveries option and select More > Reverse Delivery. > If the previous order was not delivered by Pathao Courier, then create a normal delivery. Where write in your customer details provide your store address write “Reverse Pickup” in the special instruction box and The pickup address Enter the details and submit. In this case you have to contact the Key Account Manager (KAM) / Support before 4 PM. Source: https://help.pathao.com/return-product-or-reverse-pickup-entry/

### How to change payment methods? Follow the below mentioned steps” Login to Merchant Panel > Click on profile icon >Go to Payment Information option. > After confirming the password, a page will appear to update the payment method. > For the bank, enter the account holder’s name and account number here and select the bank and branch from the dropdown list. > If you want to add bKash number, enter bKash number and save. > Within 24 hours, your new account will be approved through verification. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-to-change-payment-methods/

### Through which method and how will I receive my payment? Currently we accept payments 5 days a week (all working days) through all banks and bkash. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-will-i-receive-payment/

### How can I make an entry for a partial order? With the Partial Delivery option, you can request a new delivery by providing partial information. For partial delivery please go to dashboard <> New Deliveries <> Partial option. Click on the Partial button and a new page will appear. Save here with the following information. > Store > Customer’s phone number. > Cash Collection Amount. Note: If you have made a partial entry, you must complete the entry by 9 PM. Source: https://help.pathao.com/make-an-entry-for-a-partial-order/

### How can I place bulk order / multiple orders at once? Follow the steps below to enter the bulk order: First Click on New Delivery > Bulk Order option. Then click on “Download Sample CSV” file, fill the information according to the column and save. Finally go to “Import CSV” option and confirm by uploading your filled excel sheet. If there is a problem, it will be marked in red on the sheet. Which can be fixed and re-uploaded. Or you can check from “Go to error” option to see where the problem occurred. Source: https://help.pathao.com/place-bulk-order-or-multiple-orders/

### How to create same day delivery? Please, you will select the New Delivery option of your panel. Select “Same Day Delivery” as Delivery Type. Then provide the customer’s name, address, phone number and specify how much money you want to collect through cash on delivery in the cash amount option. Source: https://help.pathao.com/create-same-day-delivery/

### How can I change my panel password? You can easily change the panel password. Follow the steps below to change the password- Go to > Profile>Password option and enter old password and new password and click on save option > If you forget the password, you can reset the password via email from the reset password option from the merchant panel. > If still facing any kind of problem, then contact our merchant support number from your registered number. The number is – 09610003030 (from 9 am to 11 pm call this number and press 9) or email from your registered email ecomsupport@pathao.com. Passwords will be reset by us. Source: https://help.pathao.com/change-panel-password/

### What can I do if I have trouble logging into the merchant panel? Please clear your browser cache and cookies and login again and then refresh by pressing Ctrl+Shift+R. Source: https://help.pathao.com/trouble-logging-merchant-panel/

### How can I request for the store? Please go to the Stores option in the panel. And click on the Create button and provide the following information. > Store name. > Store contact name. > Contact phone number. > Select City, Zone, Area. > Detailed address of the store. Note that from the panel you can create any number of stores as you require. Source: https://help.pathao.com/request-for-the-store/

### Are there any weight or size restrictions for single or bulk parcels? Currently, we do not have any weight or size restrictions for single or bulk parcels. But the parcel must be deliverable for e-commerce logistics. Source: https://help.pathao.com/weight-or-size-restrictions-for-parcels/

### How do I create an order in the panel? To add a new parcel, you can go to Dashboard > New Delivery in your panel. Then provide the customer’s name, address, phone number, specify the weight of the parcel, quantity and how much money you want to collect through cash on delivery in the cash amount option. Also, if there is any instruction, write it in the special instruction box. Source: https://help.pathao.com/create-an-order-in-the-panel/

### What kind of service do you provide? We currently have 3 types of courier services. (i) You can use our merchant courier service if you are registered as a merchant. (ii) Besides, even if you are not our merchant, you can take the customer-to-customer courier service by booking the parcel from our booking point. (ii) If you want corporate delivery, you can contact our support number. The number is 09610003030 (from 9 am to 11 pm call this number and press 9). Source: https://help.pathao.com/types-of-services/
## Pickup ### Does Pathao pick up parcels from merchants outside Dhaka? Yes, I pick up parcels from 64 districts of Bangladesh. Source: https://help.pathao.com/pathao-pickup-outside-dhaka/

### How to solve problems related to pick up? Please follow the instructions below to avoid any problem related to pickup. > Must collect a pickup slip from the pickup agent. > Write merchant name, consignment ID, customer name, phone number and detailed address on the product. (possible If yes, take pictures of the product with and without packaging, weigh the product on the map device and keep pictures with the weight) > Entries must be made within the stipulated time (last entry time is 4 pm) Note: Please do not use a notepad on the parcel and write the required information on the parcel with a permanent marker. Source: https://help.pathao.com/solve-pick-up-problems/

### When is your last pick up time? Last time for normal delivery entry is 4 pm. Pickup starts from 2 PM and continues till 9 PM. Pickup for merchants outside Dhaka is open till 7 pm. Source: https://help.pathao.com/last-pick-up-time/
### What is our delivery schedule? Our delivery service is functional from 10 am to 7 pm and pickup service is from 2 pm to 9 pm. Source: https://help.pathao.com/delivery-schedule/

## Delivery ### How can I complain about my delivery agent or any other delivery issue? Please email us with customer details, consignment ID and required documents, and details of your issue: ecomsupport@pathao.com, we will investigate the matter within 48 hours and contact you. Source: https://help.pathao.com/complain-delivery-issue/

### If my delivery is late, what should I do? Please email us with customer details, consignment ID and required documents, and details of your issue: ecomsupport@pathao.com, the matter will be investigated and delivered promptly. Source: https://help.pathao.com/late-delivery-action/

### How can I track orders from customers to customer service? Check your SMS to track customer to customer orders. The SMS will contain a consignment ID and a tracking link. You can directly track your order by visiting the tracking link or you can track your order with Consignment ID from Courier option in your Pathao app with Consignment ID and Customer Number. Source: https://help.pathao.com/track-orders-customers-to-customer-service/

### How can I get the address of the customer service booking point from the customer? Even if you are not a merchant, you can now book parcels through Pathao Courier. Visit our booking point from 9 am to 7 pm. The address of the booking points is given below. ID | Booking Point | Address | 134572 | Bangla Bazar point | 41/1, Northbrook Hall Road, Banglabazar, Dhaka | 108077 | Gulistan point | Gulistan shopping complex Booking Point, Gulistan | 108078 | Hatirpul point | Motaleb Plaza, Ground Floor, Shop No. 105, Paribagh, Hatirpul, Dhaka | 149473 | New market Point | Shop no 32 (1st floor)Block D north,new super market dhaka | https://pathao.com/bn/blog/couriernewservice Source: https://help.pathao.com/customer-service-booking-address/

### How to enjoy corporate delivery service? If you want corporate delivery, please contact 09610003030 from 9 am to 11 pm or email ecomsupport@pathao.com. Source: https://help.pathao.com/corporate-delivery-service/

### How can I get details about product check and return policy? Please inform the customer to check the product in front of the delivery agent. If any problem is found in the product then take a picture of the product and give the product to the delivery agent immediately. If the customer receives the product and reports the problem afterwards, we have no opportunity to investigate the matter. In this case, we do not have the opportunity to take any kind of responsibility. However, if the parcel is delivered through close box delivery, the customer does not get a chance to check the parcel. However if circumstances require checking the parcel, the delivery agent will contact the merchant and provide the checked return facility with the merchant’s permission.
Source: https://help.pathao.com/product-check-and-return-policy/

### Can the product be partially delivered in Pathao? Yes, partial delivery can be done through Pathao. When the parcel is delivered to the customer, if the customer wants to take partial delivery from more than one parcel, our delivery agent will call you and inform you about it. Source: https://help.pathao.com/product-partial-delivery/

### Can product exchange be delivered in Pathao? Yes, exchange delivery can be done through Pathao. You can create an Exchange Parcel ID by going to the view option in the Delivered ID. Create an exchange ID and pick up the exchange parcel along with the regular parcel, our delivery agent will pick up the exchange parcel during delivery and you must inform the customer to return the return parcel to the delivery agent. Source: https://help.pathao.com/can-product-exchange-be-delivered/

### What kind of products does Pathao Courier deliver? We deliver all kinds of products except the following products: > Living or dead animals. > Perishable foodstuffs and food/beverages that require refrigeration or other environmental controls. > Extremely fragile items. > Firecrackers, any flammable product. > Hazardous or flammable materials. > Antiques and Artifacts. > Dry ice. > Drugs. > Commemorative coins and medals. > Boolean. > Counterfeit or pirated products. > Drugs and narcotics. > Dangerous knives. > Irreplaceable items (any item that is not normally available). > Plants / live seeds. > Pornographic materials / any illegal items. > Tobacco and tobacco products. > Illegal furs/hides/ivory and ivory products. > Tobacco and tobacco products. > Firearms and weapons (including inert and replica explosive weapons). > Prescription

drugs. > Lighter and fuel. > Passport, birth certificate, death certificate etc. > Money / Key (Key) / Transferable Securities / Payment. > For any inquiries, contact our 24/7 WhatsApp Helpline at 09610003030. Source: https://help.pathao.com/pathao-courier-delivery-items/

### Does Pathao deliver to the Cantonment Area? If the cantonment area is closed to outsiders, our deliveryman will wait at the entrance of the area, and the customer can pick up the parcel from there. Source: https://help.pathao.com/pathao-cantonment-delivery/

### What is the minimum time required to complete the delivery? > Delivery time from Dhaka to Dhaka or the same city is 24-48 hours > Delivery time from Dhaka to Dhaka sub area is 24-48 hours. > Delivery time from Chittagong to Dhaka is 24-48 hours. > Delivery time from subarea (Gazipur, Narayanganj, Savar, Keraniganj) to Dhaka is 24-48 hours. > Delivery time from Dhaka to Chittagong is 24-48 hours > Dhaka to outside Dhaka; Dhaka from outside Dhaka; Delivery time from one city outside Dhaka to another city is 3-5 days (except Friday, as some outside Dhaka on Friday to avoid activities are closed). Source: https://help.pathao.com/minimum-required-time-to-complete-delivery/

### What is the coverage area of ​​PATHAO? Currently we do home delivery all over Bangladesh except Bhasanchar, St. Martin and Chheradeep area. Source: https://help.pathao.com/coverage-area-of-pathao/

### Where is Pathao’s service available? Pathao Courier Service is currently available in 64 districts across the country extensive there is Source: https://help.pathao.com/pathao-service-availability/
# Pathao — Rider/Captain/Cyclist Help Center Copied from https://help.pathao.com for a personal learning project. Unofficial; content belongs to Pathao.
## Foodman Slotting ### How can I cancel my slot booking? Call the Supply Zonal Manager, who will cancel your booking. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-can-i-cancel-my-slot-booking/
### Can I select multiple subzones? No, you can only select one subzone. Source: https://help.pathao.com/can-i-select-multiple-subzones/

### If all slots are filled up for a specific zone, the foodman who has tried lately for that zone and could not get any slot will be eligible for another slot of another zone? Yes. If another zone has a free slot, the foodman will be eligible for it. However, a foodman should only book slots with the intention of being active during that timeslot in the chosen zone. Source: https://help.pathao.com/if-all-slots-are-filled-up-for-a-specific-zone-the-foodman-who-has-tried-lately-for-that-zone-and-could-not-get-any-slot-will-be-eligible-for-another-slot-of-another-zone/

### Is there any specific time for selecting slots? No, there is no specific time for selecting slots. A foodman can book his preferred slot according to his own convenience. Source: https://help.pathao.com/is-there-any-specific-time-for-selecting-slots/
### How long will each slot be? This will vary depending on the selected zone and subzone. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-long-will-each-slot-be/

### If a foodman misses any slot, will he be eligible for a new slot and when will we be able to inform him about this? He has to give a valid reason for missing out the slot. Unless he has a poor record and is facing suspension for any other reason, he can book new slots from his driver app himself. Source: https://help.pathao.com/if-a-foodman-misses-any-slot-will-he-be-eligible-for-a-new-slot-and-when-will-we-be-able-to-inform-him-about-this/

### How to use Delivery Slots? You will receive this pop-up right after opening the driver app: • Step 1: Click on Book a Slot • Step 2: Select Date, Zone and Subzone • Step 3: Select your desired time slots. • Step 4: Confirm Slot Timings • Step 5: Lastly, click done to complete the slotting process. Click Book New Slot to be redirected to the New Slot Booking page again. This is how you can easily book your desired slots without any hassle. • A pop -up also will also appear on the app’s screen as soon as you leave the designated sub-zone. Watch the video below to have a more detailed understanding: Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-to-use-delivery-slots/

## Rider Topup ### Do I need to adjust due before the top-up? Yes, you have to adjust due before top up if you want to do from the credit balance. Source: https://help.pathao.com/do-i-need-to-adjust-due-before-the-top-up/

### What sort of benefit will I get if I top-up through Pathao as a driver? You will get an additional data package for purchasing our combo packages. Also, you can top-up your wallet balance if there is no issue of due adjustment. Source: https://help.pathao.com/what-sort-of-benefit-will-i-get-if-i-top-up-through-pathao-as-a-driver/

### Can User use additional volume for all applications? User will not be able to use google maps through additional data. Whenever he/she will click google map, his data will be consumed from purchased data and it will pop up on the screen. Source: https://help.pathao.com/can-user-use-additional-volume-for-all-applications/
### Do I need to pay extra to get this service? No, There’s no extra charge for the Mobile top-up from Pathao App. Source: https://help.pathao.com/do-i-need-to-pay-extra-to-get-this-service/

### If I face any problem to pay with my card, how can I contact my bank? If you are not able to pay with your card, please contact your respective bank to find out whether your card is enabled for online e-commerce transactions. You can request your bank to enable it for the transaction. Source: https://help.pathao.com/if-i-face-any-problem-to-pay-with-my-card-how-can-i-contact-my-bank/

### What do I do if there are technical problems and my internet connection is disconnected in the middle of the process? Please call us or email us in the following support desk: Email: rides@pathao.com Or, report an issue from your top-up history from the Pathao app. Source: https://help.pathao.com/what-do-i-do-if-there-are-technical-problems-and-my-internet-connection-is-disconnected-in-the-middle-of-the-process/

### When can I get a refund? Any Top-Up and/or Internet Recharge purchased using Pathao is not returnable. Your payment is only refundable in the condition that the payment was made by your bank or payment Channel but service has not been provided. If payment is made and service is provided, there is no refund. Source: https://help.pathao.com/when-can-i-get-a-refund/
### Why can I not find a mobile top-up option in my app? Please update your Pathao app to our latest version. Source: https://help.pathao.com/why-can-i-not-find-a-mobile-top-up-option-in-my-app/

### I paid the amount for top-up through Pathao App and the money was deducted from my bKash/ iPay/ Upay/ ok wallet account. I did not get my top-up yet, so I need a refund. Your refund will be processed within 10 working days. If you still have problems or other queries, please share your problem details with us through Report Issue. Source: https://help.pathao.com/i-paid-the-amount-for-top-up-through-pathao-app-and-the-money-was-deducted-from-my-bkash-ipay-upay-ok-wallet-account-i-did-not-get-my-top-up-yet-so-i-need-a-refund/

### Can I recharge different numbers other than my Pathao registered number? es! You can recharge any desired number through Pathao. Similar to the process of recharging your own number, you can recharge for your friends and family’s numbers as well but it has to be a Robi or Airtel number. Source: https://help.pathao.com/can-i-recharge-different-numbers-other-than-my-pathao-registered-number/

### What is the amount limit for top-up? • The maximum number of successful top-ups per day to one beneficiary account is 20. • The maximum transferable amount for one transaction is 1000 BDT. • The minimum transferable amount for one transaction is 10 BDT. • The maximum transferable amount per day to one beneficiary account is 5000 BDT. (Beneficiary balance cannot exceed 5000 BDT). Source: https://help.pathao.com/what-is-the-amount-limit-for-top-up/

### How to top up through Pathao App? • Select “Top-Up” from the service type from the Pathao App. • Type or select a beneficiary number from your phone book. • Select your mobile operator and type (Prepaid/Postpaid). • Enter the amount or choose your desired existing package from the Packages section. • Select the payment method. • Follow the process by providing the correct information when asked After the transaction is successfully processed, you will be notified Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-to-top-up-through-pathao-app/

### What is Pathao Top-up? This is a new feature in the Pathao platform that allows you to easily recharge Mobile Airtime from using digital payment via cards, iPay, Upay, bKash, ok wallet, etc. You can do mobile recharge for your own mobile phone or for someone else’s mobile phone. Source: https://help.pathao.com/what-is-pathao-top-up/

## Captain ### How may I withdraw the amount from Digital Payment wallet? Bkash and Rocket Extraction Process: Step 1: Select Account option from Drive App Step 2: Select Withdraw Step 3: Write Withdraw amount. Give the Pin Number. Select Submit ** In the case of bKash, the amount will go instant, in the case of Rocket, the amount will go to the Rocket account in between 24 hours. In addition to Bkash and Rocket Services, you can now withdraw your Credit Balance directly from One Bank ATM booths without any charge. Select One Bank ATM among the withdrawal options from the Driver app, enter the amount of your choice and withdraw money within 5 minutes of inputting the secret PIN number by following the steps given below: Withdrawal process from One Bank ATM booth: Step 1: Press the “OK Wallet” button from ATM Booth. Step 2: Type the 11-digit code you received in

the Send app at the ATM booth. Step 3: Enter the amount of money at the ATM booth. Step 4: An OTP will be sent to your phone message, type it in the ATM booth. Step 5: Collect money and pick up the receipt. Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-may-i-withdraw-the-amount-from-digital-payment-wallet/

### How Can I Be A Fleet Partner or Admiral? How can I track the car I have added to Pathao Cars? To add and manage multiple cars on the Pathao platform, become an Admiral today! If you have a car registered on your name driven by a driver and you want to keep track while sharing rides with Pathao, here are the requirements: 1. NID 2. Phone number 3. Vehicle Doc Source: https://help.pathao.com/how-can-i-be-a-fleet-partner-or-admiral-how-can-i-track-the-car-i-have-added-to-pathao-cars/

### Why is my account suspended? How can I withdraw it? Call our helpline to find out the reason and duration of your suspension and to withdraw suspension please visit the Pathao Walk-in-Support Center. ## Pay Later ### Pay Later – Frequently Asked Questions #### What is this feature? Pay Later is a special subscription service offered to an exclusive group of Pathao customers. Users can order food, rides and parcels from Pathao in a single tap, with no upfront payments, and can pay us back within 30 days. Pay smarter, pay later.

#### How do I subscribe to this feature? To provide you this seamless experience, we will charge a small subscription fee for Pay Later that will be added to the end of your next billing cycle. When you subscribe, you can choose your desired package as per your requirements.

#### What are billing cycles? A billing cycle is the time between the billing start and end date. There are two cycles every month. The first cycle is from 1st – 15th of a month. The second cycle is from the 16th day to the last day of the month. At the end of a billing cycle, you will have 30 days to clear your dues.

#### How will I clear my dues? For each billing cycle, due is payable within 30 days. For example, if you spend ৳2000 between the 1st and the 15th of September, you will be billed for that period and have to complete payment before the 15th of October.

#### What are the differences between the different packages? The differences between the packages are in the number of billing cycles you subscribe for, the % of discount you get with each Pay Later payment and the maximum discount you can avail.

#### What happens if I pay late? Late fees and blocking We highly encourage you to complete your payment within due time. We give you a grace period of 7 days to pay back your dues after the stated due date. However, if you still haven’t paid back your dues, you will be blocked from using all Pathao services until you pay. In addition, a flat one-time fee of 10% on your due will be applied, capped at a maximum of ৳250. We apply a late fee separately for each due, so if you go overdue on several dues, the late fee applies to each due. To illustrate: • If you have a ৳2000 bill, you are charged 10% x ৳2000 = ৳200 • If you have a ৳3000 due, the late fee is 10% x ৳3000 = ৳300, but we cap it at ৳250 We will always be upfront with you about your late fees for each due. We’ll also give you ample warning that late fees will be

applied. If exceptional circumstances are hindering your ability to pay back your dues, please get in touch with us, and we’ll do our best to support you however we can. Your due limit Unfortunately, if you display a recent history of late payments, we will decrease the due limit that you have available to use on your purchases. To increase your due limit again, continue to pay your dues (ideally early!), and you’ll get back your due limit in no-time!

#### When and how can I repay my dues? Anytime. You can instantly repay your dues at any point using a range of digital payment services. Just go to the “Pay Later” widget, tap “Dues”, and follow the on-screen instructions. Remember to pay on time to avoid late fees. If you pay early, you will get priority access to higher due limits!
#### How can I earn Pathao Points by using Pay Later? When you clear your Pay Later dues, you automatically earn some Pathao Points. For every 1,000 BDT, you will earn 10 Pathao Points.

#### How can I increase my due limit? Your due limit is personalized to you, and we review it regularly to ensure it meets your needs. To increase your due limit, consider doing the following: a. Purchase more through Pathao, ideally by using Pay Later b. Ensure you have a valid digital payment method (e.g., BKash, cards) connected to your Pathao account. c. Try to pay dues as early as possible and avoid paying late. d. Maintain a good standing on Pathao by avoiding fraudulent activity.
#### Where can I use the pay later feature? You can use Pay Later for food, rides & parcels.

#### If I’m not eligible, what can I do to get access? Firstly, we’re super excited to hear that you’re keen to use PayLater! To become eligible, please do the following: a. Register interest on our waitlist: Opt-into the PayLater waitlist through the PayLater tile in the Pathao App. You can also pre-register for PayLater, which will increase your priority in the waiting list! b. Continue using Pathao services: Take a few rides around the city with a Pathao Car, or order a meal to treat your special someone through Pathao Food. Our most loyal customers get priority access!

#### I was eligible to sign-up, but wasn’t given access when I tried to register. Why? In a rare few cases, we’re not able to onboard certain users even though they were originally marked as eligible for paying later. Most of the time, we will let you know why we’re not able to onboard you. Typically, you will be made eligible over time – you might just have to wait a bit longer! Keep using Pathao services to increase your position on the eligibility waitlist. If you still have questions or concerns, do not hesitate to contact support.
#### How do I find my transaction history? Easy as pie! Open-up the Pathao app, select the “Pay Later” widget, go to “Transactions”, and you’ll find a full history of your transactions and dues.
#### Where can I find the Terms & Conditions for this feature? You can find our detailed Terms and Conditions here

#### What happens if my balance limit or any other fee structures change? We believe in being fully transparent about how this feature works. We’ll send you every detail about any changes, and how it may impact your experience with paying later. We’ll always make sure we are transparent in the Pathao app. No legal jargon, no hidden fees. We promise.

#### I still need to contact support / I want to provide feedback. What should I do? Support Sorry to hear that your experience with our pay later feature was not up to the mark! You can reach us by email at cx@pathao.com or by phone at 09678100800. We’re open 24/7, so do not hesitate to get in touch! Feedback We’re eager to hear from you! Do reach-out to us with any feedback at cx@pathao.com or by phone at 09678100800. We’re looking forward to hearing from you! Source: https://help.pathao.com/faq-paylater/
